headline: Putin: Ukraina “kompromiss”ga borishi kerak, Qrim ko‘prigiga berilgan zarbaga javob “og‘riqli” bo‘ladi
summary: Putin said Ukraine should accept a US-proposed compromise to end the war and that Moscow does not intend to return occupied Ukrainian territory. He also promised a painful response to strikes on the Crimean bridge.
why: Russia's war with Ukraine affects energy and grain supplies, sanctions and European security, all of which feed into commodity and risk markets. Statements on negotiations can shift investor expectations about sanctions relief.
